note: Real placements only. Bears are called minibosses here because they are the only repeated elite block (hp 7, contact 1.5). The game has no miniboss type. Major rows are four campaign checkpoints of the one placed boss, the Sentinel. Resident is defined in ENEMY_HP and is not placed.
majorCheckpoints: quarry sentinel, cycle 0, wanderer, no upgrades
quarry sentinel, cycle 2, vitality 1 / edge 1 / stride 1, boots
quarry sentinel, cycle 5, vitality 3 / edge 3 / stride 3, shadow step, wraith bond
soloverse sentinel, cycle 5, same ranks, tropoverse HP ×1.35 and slash ×1.2

builds.early: cycle 0 wanderer, flaw cannot_rest, starter iron, no dash, no bottle
builds.middle: cycle 2 wanderer, one rank in vitality edge stride, boots, one syrup in the assisted policy only
builds.late: cycle 5 wanderer, ranks capped on vitality edge stride, shadow step, wraith bond

policies.standard: Hold about 20px, face the target, slash when the 0.22s hurt gate is open. No sip, no bomb, no spin.
policies.assisted: Retreat a little earlier, dash if boots or the form allow, sip syrup when HP is at or under the next contact hit.
